prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1373; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while the vehicle was turning left, reporting right knee pain and limited range of motion. Over the course of 17 visits, treatment included physical examination, imaging review, a structured physical therapy program, and activity modification. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the reported knee complaints. Examination revealed findings that support a meaningful knee injury, including tenderness along the joint line and reduced flexion, while several other tests, including ligament stability assessments, were within normal limits. No prior injury to the same body region is known to this provider. Care followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as pain and function improved and the patient was discharged to a home exercise program. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries.
